serviceDescription:
1. [Service Description] Read-only onchain planning. Returns a validated cross-chain plan, structured goal and summary; does not sign or execute. The complete plan is prepared before the payment challenge. Invalid or unclear requests return 400/422 before payment; successful paid replay returns the prepared plan.
2. [Parameter Spec] goal(string, optional): 6-600 characters describing the desired outcome; if omitted, plans the demo goal Supply 100 USD₮0 on X Layer into Aave; walletAddress(string, optional): EVM 0x address for public onchain balances; if omitted, uses a clearly labelled demo portfolio. Replay the same parameters after payment.
3. [Request Method] POST
4. [Request Example] curl -i -X POST 'https://waypoint.cjlin.com/asp/plan' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"goal":"Supply 100 USD₮0 on X Layer into Aave"}'
